title: Support Worker
description:
Support Worker and Healthcare Assistants - Agency

We are seeking a compassionate and dedicated Support Workers AND Healthcare Assistants to join our team. The ideal candidate will provide essential support to individuals in various settings, including home care, assisted living, and nursing homes. This role is vital in enhancing the quality of life for those in need, particularly seniors and individuals with dementia or other health challenges. As a Support Worker, you will be responsible for delivering personalised care while ensuring the dignity and respect of each individual.

Duties as a Support Worker:
- Provide patient care and assistance with daily living activities, including personal hygiene and grooming.
- Offer dementia care support, ensuring a safe and comforting environment for individuals experiencing cognitive challenges.
- Assist with meal preparation, ensuring nutritional needs are met according to dietary requirements.
- Administer medication as prescribed and monitor the health status of clients, reporting any changes to relevant professionals.
- Engage in meaningful activities that promote social interaction and mental stimulation for clients.
- Maintain accurate records of care provided and any observations during shifts.
- Collaborate with healthcare professionals to develop and implement individualised care plans.
- Provide companionship and emotional support to clients, fostering a trusting relationship.

Skills as a Support Worker:
- Strong background in patient care, with experience in senior care or hospice care preferred.
- Knowledge of dementia care principles and practices is highly advantageous.
- Ability to perform medication administration safely and effectively.
- Experience in home care settings or nursing homes is beneficial.
- Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to engage effectively with clients and their families.
- Empathy, patience, and a genuine desire to help others are essential qualities for this role.
- Strong organisational skills to manage multiple tasks efficiently while maintaining attention to detail.

If you are passionate about making a difference in the lives of others and possess the necessary skills to provide high-quality support, we encourage you to apply for this rewarding position as a Support Worker.

Job Types: Full-time, Part-time

Benefits:
- Referral programme

Physical Setting:
- Care home
- Nursing home
- Residential home
- Supported living

Work days:
- Every weekend
- Monday to Friday

Language:
- English (required)

Work Location: In person

title: Care Assistant
description:
Care Assistant

Location: Oxford

Salary: £13.91 per hour to £14.54 per hour (pay award pending December 2026)

Vacancy Type: Permanent

At Fairfield, care is more than a job it s an opportunity to change lives every single day. We re proud to provide a warm, welcoming and homely environment where residents feel valued, respected and supported to live life to the full.

As a Care Assistant, you ll make a real difference, building meaningful relationships, promoting independence and bringing comfort, companionship and happiness to our residents. You ll be joining a friendly, supportive team where compassion, reliability and teamwork really matter.

At Fairfield, we believe that the right personality matters just as much as experience or qualifications. If you re caring, compassionate and enjoy making a difference to others, we d love to hear from you! Whether you re new to care or looking to develop your existing skills, we ll support you with training, help you gain a relevant qualification if you choose to do so, and give you the opportunity to grow in confidence and build a rewarding career. And you ll be in great hands! In May 2025, Fairfield was named Oxfordshire Apprenticeship Employer of the Year (under 250 employees). We were also Highly Commended in the SME Apprenticeship Employer of the Year category at the National Apprenticeship and Skills Awards for the South-East Region in October 2025.

What we offer:
- Competitive rates of pay;
- Standard Life auto-enrolment pension scheme;
- Apprenticeships, continuous learning and development, professional development and
- Study support opportunities;
- Free meals while on shift;
- Free parking while on shift subject to availability;
- Free uniforms (or £150 annual clothing allowance for Social Wellbeing and
- Maintenance);
- An employee assistance programme with a range of services including shopping discounts, financial and legal advice, counselling and a health and wellbeing smartphone app;
- Access to chaplaincy support
- A joining bonus of £250 payable on successful completion of your probationary period.

Pre-employment checks:

All successful candidates will be required to complete satisfactory pre-employment checks, including references, an enhanced DBS check, and verification of their right to work in the UK. Please note that Fairfield is unable to offer visa sponsorship.

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Fairfield Residential Home, please do not hesitate to apply.

The closing date for applications is midday on Monday 16th November 2026, but early application is advised as we reserve the right to close applications and appoint before this date for the right candidate.
